title: EmDash backup and restore check read SQLite through node:sqlite, not host python3 (3.40)
steps: S1: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): O, seat A's cookie, api, pq, HOST; PRIV=$(docker inspect $HOST --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^TRACY_PRIVATE_ROOT=//p').
S2: Pick S = an EmDash site A owns where Restore everything is allowed (scv2 stand: qa1em03.scv2.tracy.test; never scv2*); L = the part of S before the first '.'.

S3: Run docker exec $HOST node --no-warnings -e 'process.exit(typeof require("node:sqlite").backup === "function" ? 0 : 1)'; echo rc=$? — then docker exec $HOST test -f /opt/tracy-fleet/lib/sqlite-tool.mjs; echo rc=$?

S4: Record only (no verdict): docker exec $HOST python3 -c 'import sqlite3;print(sqlite3.sqlite_version)'; docker exec $HOST node --no-warnings -e 'const {DatabaseSync}=require("node:sqlite");console.log(new DatabaseSync(":memory:").prepare("select sqlite_version() v").get().v)'; docker exec -w /app <L>-web-1 node -e 'const D=require("better-sqlite3");console.log(new D(":memory:").prepare("select sqlite_version() v").get().v)'.
S5: Run api a POST /api/sites/<S>/backup '{"title":"REG-002-point","notes":""}'; record N = body.version and body.database.

S6: Run ls -lA $PRIV/<L>/backups/; shasum -a 256 $PRIV/<L>/backups/v<N>.sqlite.gz; wc -c < $PRIV/<L>/backups/v<N>.sqlite.gz; git --git-dir=$PRIV/<L>/webroot-baseline.git tag -l --format='%(contents)' tracy-release/v<N>.

S7: Run docker exec $HOST sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); gzip -dc "$TRACY_PRIVATE_ROOT/$1/backups/v$2.sqlite.gz" > "$d/x.db"; node --no-warnings /opt/tracy-fleet/lib/sqlite-tool.mjs check "$d/x.db"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; echo rc=$rc' sh <L> <N>.

S9: Run pq "select action,status,coalesce(error,'') from site_operation where site_key='<S>' order by created_at desc limit 1"; poll curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://<L>.scv2.tracy.test:34080/ every 5 s until 200 (≤120 s); run api a GET /api/sites/<S>/backups.
expect: S3: both commands print rc=0 (the branch lib/site-backup.sh _tracy_sqlite takes is node:sqlite, not python3).

S5: HTTP 200, ok true, database.state 'full', engine 'sqlite', size > 0, sha256 = 64 lowercase hex (pre-fix: database.state 'none'; host python3 SQLite 3.40 failed with 'malformed database schema … near ORDER').

S6: v<N>.sqlite.gz and v<N>.uploads.tar.gz exist, both -rw-------; no entry starting with '.v<N>.' (no .tmp/-wal/-shm left); sha256 of v<N>.sqlite.gz == database.sha256; its byte count == database.size.
S6: tag contents contain 'Tracy-Database: sha256:<database.sha256> size:<database.size> kind:sqlite tables:<n>' with n ≥ 1, and a line starting 'Tracy-Uploads: sha256:'.
S7: last line is 'rc=0' and the integer printed before it equals the trailer's tables:<n>.
S8: HTTP 200, ok true, status 'succeeded', version == N (pre-fix: 409 BACKUP_NOT_FULL, or 409 RESTORE_REFUSED reason RESTORE_FAILED at the load/check step).

S9: latest site_operation: action 'restore-everything', status 'succeeded', error empty; site answers 200 within 120 s; /backups has a row kind 'backup', auto 'pre-restore', version N+1, database.state 'full', engine 'sqlite'.
evidence: tasks/evidence/site-changes-v2/qa/r1/bugs/QA-I01.md (fix 8bff4ef63; side files d131ca337); the QA note is Studio-local (not in git), the fix commit is on develop
fence: packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/scripts/lib/site-backup.sh _tracy_sqlite sends EmDash backup and integrity/table check (dump, restore load, post-swap check) through lib/sqlite-tool.mjs on node:sqlite (3.53) instead of the host's python3 SQLite 3.40.
